properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued July 15 at 2:18PM MDT until July 15 at 5:15PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Kane County in southern Utah...Specifically for Wire
Pass and Buckskin Gulch...

* Until 515 PM MDT.

* At 218 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over Wire Pass and upper portions of Buckskin Gulck.
Between 0.25 and 0.35 inches of rain have fallen. Additional
rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.35 inches are possible in the warned
area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms
producing flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of normally dry washes
and slot canyons.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Wire Pass and Buckskin Gulch

creeks.
